svg.title: Notifications and reminders
svg.desc: 3 English interface examples. From an app that waits to be opened, through reminders the person sets, the church’s hours of prayer, a daily word and messages from people, to notifications tuned to bring people back and an AI that writes first: decide who chooses the interruption, how urgent it claims to be, what it says to someone who has been away, and what reaches someone at night.
